signals.signal: ATM PURCHASE AWARDED AGAINST PRINTEC: 81 ATMs (36 through-the-wall, 37 lobby, 8 full-cycle recyclers), expected UAH 55,264,689 incl. VAT, delivery by 01/12/2026. Only two bidders: TOV PRINTEC UKRAINE LLC (#35442628) and TOV ATM SISTEMS (#44372551). Award 16/04/2026 to ATM Sistems at UAH 49,720,800 incl. VAT (UAH 5,541,224.34 below Printec's bid, 10.03% below estimate). Printec Ukraine filed a formal complaint on 17/04/2026 arguing the winner offered equipment from a manufacturer with control/business links to the Russian Federation, a national-security risk; Ukrgasbank REJECTED the complaint on the merits. Earlier identical tender UA-2025-11-20-012352-a (same UAH 55,264,689) failed ('torhy ne vidbulysya'); bidders had asked to split it into lots and to relax the '5 recycling cassettes + 1 reject/retract' spec.
signals.implies: Printec (1) ATM & cash recycling lost an 81-unit Ukrainian bank ATM order to ATM Sistems on price. ATM Sistems (#44372551) is now a first-class competitor in Ukraine. The rejected Russia-linkage complaint is a reusable compliance argument for future UA bids.
signals.followup: Identify ATM Sistems' ATM manufacturer/brand; brief Printec UA on re-running the security-linkage argument via AMCU rather than the buyer.

signals.entity: Printec Ukraine LLC (TOV PRINTEC UKRAINE EL.EL.SI., EDRPOU 35442628) / Ukrgasbank
signals.signal: PRINTEC WIN: Ukrgasbank awarded Printec Ukraine the software technical-support contract for Castles Saturn 1000F2 POS terminals, UAH 277,200 incl. VAT, awarded 10/06/2026, service period to 31/05/2027. CPV 72260000-5.
signals.implies: Confirms Printec (3) POS/terminal management incumbency at Ukrgasbank via its Castles partnership; a warm account despite the ATM loss.
signals.followup: Renewal window ~Q1 2027; use as reference to re-enter Ukrgasbank ATM hardware.

signals.signal: Award: 20,000 Newland N950 portable Android POS terminals with HAL API, USD 2,180,000 (UAH 98,054,220), winner NEWLAND PAYMENT TECHNOLOGY (H.K.) COMPANY LIMITED (#69372357), delivery by 08/09/2026, CPV 30140000-2. Bank ref PB-2026-01-30-3067542.
signals.implies: PrivatBank sourced 20k Android POS direct from the Chinese OEM, bypassing a regional integrator entirely. Structural threat to Printec (3) POS/acquiring, x-pos, TMS, POSight and softPOS in Ukraine.
signals.followup: Check whether TMS/estate management and field service for the 20k Newland fleet is tendered separately.

signals.signal: Award: 3x Thales payShield 10000 hardware security modules (HSM, the tamper-resistant boxes that hold payment encryption keys), Standard Build with PS10-RPM-X Premium package, EUR 282,450 excl. VAT, winner Apius Technologies SA (Poland, VAT 9452155088), delivery by 21/07/2026. Bank ref PB-2026-03-25-3068555.
signals.implies: Direct hit on Printec (9) payment security & key management (Thales payShield). A Polish integrator, Apius Technologies, is supplying Thales HSMs into Ukraine's largest bank.
signals.followup: Add Apius Technologies SA to the competitor register as a cross-border Thales channel rival.

signals.signal: Award: Thales payShield 10000 technical support (STANDARD SUPPORT level + local first-line), EUR 130,526.31 excl. VAT, winner Apius Technologies SA, coverage to 07/04/2029, CPV 50312600-1. Bank ref PB-2026-02-19-3067727.
signals.implies: Apius locks PrivatBank HSM support to 2029 - Printec (9)/(11) shut out of that annuity until then.

signals.signal: Award: postal self-service terminals (parcel lockers / 'poshtomat') with installation - 1,000 main modules, 1,000 additional modules type 1, 200 type 2, 100 high-autonomy batteries, 50 chargers, 500 solar panels; expected UAH 211,932,000 incl. Funded 100% from Ukrposhta's own budget.

signals.followup: Flag Modern-Expo as a regional kiosk competitor; check whether Ukrposhta will tender payment/cash acceptance modules or field service separately.
